title: Generalised Probabilistic Modelling and Improved Uncertainty Estimation in Comparative LLM-as-a-judge
paper_type_zh: 比较式 LLM judge 的概率建模、主动比较与不确定性评测研究
best_for_zh: 需要以较少成对比较获得稳定候选排序并量化置信度的研究者。
one_line: Develops uncertainty estimates for comparative LLM judging and ranking stability.
用广义概率模型与重排序概率，减少成对 LLM judge 排名所需比较。
why: It adds a paper-backed reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: evaluator/reward/verifier reliability, attack, uncertainty, or reward-hacking research.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Comparative LLM-as-a-judge can rank candidate generations well, but exhaustive pairwise comparisons are expensive and common confidence scores are poorly calibrated. Consequently, selecting the next comparison by minimum uncertainty can waste budget or even degrade a partial ranking.

This paper recasts comparative and absolute judge outputs as a general probabilistic Product-of-Experts (PoE) problem. It derives uncertainty for individual comparisons and for the whole ranking, then uses it to select the next informative comparison rather than evaluating every pair.

比较式 LLM-as-a-judge 虽能给候选回答排序，却常需穷举成对比较，成本随候选数快速增加；常用置信度又校准不佳。若按最小不确定性挑选下一对，有限预算可能被浪费，部分比较下的排序甚至会变差。

论文把比较式和绝对式 judge 输出统一为广义概率 Product-of-Experts（PoE）问题，为单次比较与整体排序推导不确定性，再据此主动选择信息量最高的比较，而非评完所有成对组合。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The core object is a probabilistic ranking model whose experts encode judge logits for pairwise or absolute scores. Soft Bradley--Terry becomes one special case; generalized Beta or Gaussian experts and a Laplace covariance yield a score distribution, a pairwise variance, and a probability that two items will reorder. That last quantity targets ranking error directly, so it can spend comparisons where a ranking is most likely to change. The paper reports no confirmed public code or dataset release.
核心对象是概率排序模型：专家项编码 judge 对成对比较或绝对打分的 logits。soft Bradley--Terry 只是特例；广义 Beta、Gaussian 专家及 Laplace 协方差共同给出分数分布、成对方差与两项发生重排序的概率。后者直接针对排序错误，因而把比较预算投向最可能改变名次的位置。论文未确认公开代码或可下载数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect judge evidence. For candidate responses, obtain comparative or absolute output probabilities from an LLM judge.
  1. Fit a PoE ranking model. Map each output to a comparative expert; combine experts to infer latent item scores. The paper compares soft Bradley--Terry, generalized Beta, Gaussian, and comparative-plus-absolute variants.
  1. Estimate uncertainty. Use a Laplace approximation around the inferred scores to obtain covariance, pairwise variance, and probability of reordering.
  1. Acquire and update. Select the pair with high reordering probability, query it, refit, and stop at the allotted comparison budget. Prompt templates, temperatures, and code are not publicly confirmed.

1. 收集 judge 证据。 对候选回答取得 LLM judge 的成对或绝对输出概率。
  1. 拟合 PoE 排序模型。 将输出映射为比较专家并合并，推断项目的潜在分数；比较 soft Bradley--Terry、广义 Beta、Gaussian 及比较—绝对混合模型。
  1. 估计不确定性。 在分数附近作 Laplace 近似，得到协方差、成对方差和重排序概率。
  1. 主动获取并更新。 选择重排序概率高的一对、查询后重拟合，至比较预算耗尽为止。提示词、温度和代码未公开确认。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim. Reordering-aware acquisition reaches accurate comparative rankings with fewer judge calls. Setup. On SummEval attributes, Flan-T5-3B and Qwen judges provide biased or debiased probabilities; the baseline is soft Bradley--Terry with minimum-uncertainty selection. Result. To reach 90% of full-comparison performance, the proposed uncertainty metrics require about 60% fewer comparisons for Flan-T5 and 50% fewer for Qwen than that baseline; probability of reordering is the most robust selector. Boundary. This supports efficiency on these ranking settings, not calibrated uncertainty for arbitrary judges or domains.

主张。 以重排序风险选对可减少 judge 调用而保持排序。设置。 在 SummEval 属性上，Flan-T5-3B 与 Qwen judge 提供带/去偏概率；基线为 soft Bradley--Terry 加最小不确定性选择。结果。 达到全比较性能的 90% 时，提出的不确定性指标相对基线少用约 60%（Flan-T5）和 50%（Qwen）比较，重排序概率最稳健。边界。 这只支持这些排序设置的效率，不证明任意 judge 或领域都校准良好。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier comparative-assessment PoE work models incomplete pairwise comparisons, usually with soft Bradley--Terry and a minimum-uncertainty acquisition rule. This paper changes the decision object: it generalizes the expert likelihood and chooses comparisons by their probability of changing the inferred ranking, while also defining uncertainty over the final ranking. Its novelty is not pairwise LLM judging itself, but an uncertainty contract aligned with ranking decisions and optional absolute-score experts.
既有 PoE 比较评测已能以不完整成对结果建模，通常采用 soft Bradley--Terry 与最小不确定性选对。本文改变的是决策对象：推广专家似然，用“比较会否改变推断排序”的概率选择下一对，并定义最终排名的不确定性。新意不在成对 LLM judge 本身，而在与排序决策对齐的不确定性契约及可选绝对打分专家。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors identify the Laplace approximation as the central limitation: it assumes an approximately Gaussian posterior, which can be inaccurate for multimodal or skewed score posteriors; then the acquisition signal can be wrong. Reuse should compare its uncertainty against held-out ranking errors rather than trust it by construction. The reported efficiency is centered on SummEval and two judge families, so transfer to a new rubric, prompt, or candidate distribution requires a fresh calibration check. No confirmed code release also limits exact replication.
作者指出核心限制是 Laplace 近似：它假定分数后验近似 Gaussian；若真实后验多峰或偏斜，不确定性和选对信号都可能失真。复用时应以留出排序误差检验该信号，而不能默认可信。效率证据集中于 SummEval 与两类 judge，换 rubric、提示词或候选分布须重新校准；未确认代码发布也限制精确复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For a system that must rank many answers with a fixed pairwise rubric, use judge probabilities as PoE inputs, query high-reordering pairs first, and return both a ranking and uncertainty. Validate success with rank correlation and calibration against a human-held-out subset at the intended budget. It is useful for comparison-budget planning and for flagging unstable rank regions. Do not use it as a drop-in correctness verifier when the task lacks a meaningful pairwise preference signal, or when posterior calibration cannot be checked.
若系统要以固定成对 rubric 给大量回答排序，可将 judge 概率作为 PoE 输入，优先查询重排序概率高的对，输出排序及不确定性。用目标预算下的人类留出集检查 rank correlation 和校准，才可确认复用有效。它适合规划比较预算、标记名次不稳区域；若任务没有有意义的成对偏好，或无法检查后验校准，则不能当作正确性 verifier 直接使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: it turns comparative judging from exhaustive ranking into uncertainty-guided acquisition.
  • Lever: PoE score inference plus Laplace covariance produces a probability of reordering for each candidate pair.
  • Artifact: UAI paper only; no verified public code or dataset link.
  • Evidence: on SummEval, 90%-of-final performance needs roughly 60% fewer Flan-T5 and 50% fewer Qwen comparisons than minimum uncertainty.
  • Reuse decision: calibrate on a held-out human ranking; avoid it when Gaussian posterior approximation is visibly poor.

• 定位： 将穷举式比较评测改为不确定性驱动的主动获取。
  • 方法抓手： PoE 分数推断加 Laplace 协方差，为每个候选对计算重排序概率。
  • 工件： 已核验 UAI 论文，未确认公开代码或数据集。
  • 证据锚点： SummEval 上达到最终性能 90% 时，比最小不确定性少约 60% 的 Flan-T5 和 50% 的 Qwen 比较。
  • 复用决定： 先用人类留出排序做校准；Gaussian 后验近似明显不佳时避免采用。
